strategy_roster.name: NRTR ATR Stop
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) and ATR(14)/ATR-SMA(20) are explicit fallbacks for the NRTR trailing reversal because no values are supplied. Its coefficient, signal-bar delay, and stateful ATR stop are not exactly representable.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Buy Sell Force
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) versus its EMA(9) is an explicit fallback for the smoothed cc/bb pressure lines. The source supplies no periods or signal exit, so the inverse cross is used.

strategy_roster.name: PivotEMA3RLHv4
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(open,3) > ema(close,3) and close > sma(close,20) and atr(high,low,close,14) > sma(atr(high,low,close,14),14)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA(3) open/close relation is exact; SMA(20) and ATR expansion are explicit fallbacks for the pivot and multi-ATR filters. Heikin-Ashi confirmation and staged pip trailing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: EMA Trend Heikin Ashi Entry
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= bb_lower(close,20,2) and close > open and ema(close,9) > ema(close,21)
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish regular candle at Bollinger(20,2) and EMA 9/21 proxy the Heikin-Ashi pullback reversal. Explicit prior-candle lows, higher-timeframe EMA, first-R target, and trailing state are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: XDerivative
strategy_roster.notes: EMA-smoothed ROC(34) with length 7 approximates the Jurik-smoothed derivative and its zero turn. The documented 1% stop and 2% target are retained.

strategy_roster.name: VWAP Breakout ATR
strategy_roster.notes: A 20-bar volume-weighted mean is an explicit period fallback for VWAP. ATR stop and target multipliers are dynamic price distances and are omitted from percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Levels With Revolve
strategy_roster.notes: The documented default LevelPrice=100 is used directly for both crossings. Stop and target default to zero, and optional reversal order handling is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Sign
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) thresholds 30 and 70 provide the long reversal entry and mirror-signal exit. ATR(14) is only an arrow offset in the source, and no stop is implemented.

strategy_roster.name: I Gap
strategy_roster.notes: A 0.5% opening gap is an explicit normalization for the documented five price steps, with the mirror gap closing long. The broker price step and position flags are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Classic Nacked Z-Score Arbitrage
strategy_roster.notes: A 60-day single-price z-score and thresholds -1/0 proxy the unsupported two-asset spread. This represents the long second leg; simultaneous legs and second-security data are unavailable.
